headline: Fever-Sky is most-watched regular-season WNBA game since 1997
description: The Fever-Sky game Sunday averaged 3.31 million viewers on NBC and Peacock to make it the most-watched regular-season WNBA game since the league's inaugural season in 1997.

headline: Unrivaled adding more travel in 2027 amid soaring valuation
description: Unrivaled will expand to more road trips outside Miami in 2027 as the league announced a valuation of $650 million and that the players equity pool is up 550% since 2024.

headline: Opals captain Sami Whitcomb to miss FIBA World Cup
description: The Australian Opals' FIBA World Cup campaign has suffered a major blow with captain Sami Whitcomb withdrawing from the tournament which tips off next week in Germany.

headline: Mystics beat the Mercury 94-84 for 2nd-most regular-season victories in franchise history
description: — Sonia Citron had 19 points and nine assists, Kiki Iriafen added 18 points and 10 rebounds for her 17th double-double of the season, and the Washington Mystics beat the Phoenix Mercury 94-84 on Tuesday night.

headline: Dallas Wings secure final WNBA playoff berth with 23rd win
description: The Dallas Wings claimed the eighth and final WNBA playoff spot Tuesday with their 96-78 victory over the Portland Fire at College Park Center, sending star guard Paige Bueckers, the 2025 No. 1 pick, to the postseason for the first time.

headline: Wings beat the Fire 96-78 to clinch the final WNBA playoff spot
description: — Paige Bueckers had 22 points and 11 assists, Jessica Shepard added 21 points, nine rebounds and six assists, and the Dallas Wings beat the Portland Fire 96-78 on Tuesday night to clinch the final WNBA playoff spot.

description: — Aaliyah Edwards scored a career-high 26 points to go with 10 rebounds, and Diamond Miller added 21 points as the Connecticut Sun beat the Chicago Sky 87-81 on Tuesday night.

headline: Sky ban Kanter Freedom from arena after clash with Cloud
description: Chicago Sky owner Michael Alter said Enes Kanter Freedom was banned from Wintrust Arena after showing he had the potential to be a threat when he was removed for a verbal altercation with a Sky player during a game Sunday.

headline: Angel Reese sets WNBA single-game, season rebounding records
description: Angel Reese set a WNBA record with 26 rebounds in the Dream's 78-71 win over the Sparks on Monday, pushing her past the league's season record in the same game.

headline: Angel Reese breaks WNBA single-game and season rebounding records as Dream beat Sparks 78-71
description: — Angel Reese broke the WNBA single-game rebounding record with 26 while also breaking the league's season record for rebounds as the Atlanta Dream beat the Los Angeles Sparks 78-71 on Monday night.
